boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named SMU spaces for focused work, collaborative sessions, and campus recreation.

cards.title: Fondren Library Collaborative Commons
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · first floor
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the tables, booths, and monitors for collaborative work; conversation is allowed in this first-floor space.
cards.short_summary: A social study setting with booths, tables, monitors, and a nearby café.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries describes the Collaborative Commons as a busy first-floor area with tables, booths, four monitors, and collaborative study where conversation is allowed.
cards.access_notes: Open-study availability and public-access hours should be checked with SMU Libraries before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library 1st Floor MeSpace Study Pod
cards.title: Fondren’s MeSpace Study Pod
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use this first-come, first-served pod when you need to narrow distractions and work solo near, but apart from, the first-floor activity.
cards.short_summary: A single-person focus pod tucked near Fondren’s active first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries says Fondren’s MeSpace is a first-come, first-served study pod designed to limit distractions and help users focus.
cards.access_notes: Located near the first-floor Starbucks area; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Centennial Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose a four- or six-person table for a quieter reading session, and plug in at the lamps and electrical outlets built into the tables.
cards.short_summary: A large quiet room with shared tables, lamps, outlets, and Fondren reference materials.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries identifies the Centennial Reading Room as a large quiet-study room with four- and six-person tables, lamps, outlets, and the reference collection.
cards.access_notes: Second-floor Fondren space; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Hillcrest Exhibit Hall Study Area
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · second floor
cards.notes: Set up for quiet study in the second-floor hall across from the Centennial Reading Room, especially when you want a defined reading-area setting.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study area in Fondren’s second-floor exhibit hall.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries states that the Hillcrest Exhibit Hall study area, across the foyer from the Centennial Reading Room, is available for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Second-floor Fondren space; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Prothro Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · first floor
cards.notes: Pick a computer desk, casual seat, or large group table depending on the task, then use the nearby Print Copy Scan room when needed.
cards.short_summary: A high-traffic learning commons combining computers, group tables, casual seating, and print services.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries says the Prothro Learning Commons has PC and Mac computers, varied seating, large group tables, and a nearby Print Copy Scan room.
cards.access_notes: This is a high-traffic area where conversation is allowed; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library Fourth Floor Study Area
cards.title: Fondren Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · fourth floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs for focused work with campus views; choose among carrels, small tables, high-top seating, or casual seating based on your task.
cards.short_summary: Fondren’s quietest floor offers varied individual-study seating and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries calls Fondren’s fourth floor the library’s quietest floor and lists study carrels, small tables, high-top seating, casual seating, and campus views.
cards.access_notes: Fourth-floor Fondren space; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Hamon Arts Library First Floor Study Area
cards.title: Hamon Arts Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Hamon Arts Library · first floor
cards.notes: Work at a window table or near the periodicals and reference section, and use the nearby printing, scanning, and copying services when appropriate.
cards.short_summary: An arts-library study floor with window seating, reference materials, and nearby technology services.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries describes Hamon’s first floor as offering study tables near periodicals, reference materials, windows, outlets, and printing, scanning, and copying services.
cards.access_notes: Quiet conversation is allowed on this floor; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Hamon Arts Library First Floor MeSpace Study Pod
cards.title: Hamon’s MeSpace Study Pod
cards.subtitle: Hamon Arts Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-come, first-served study pod for an individual concentration session when a more enclosed, low-distraction setup fits your work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet one-person focus option inside Hamon Arts Library.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries describes Hamon’s first-floor MeSpace as a first-come, first-served study pod intended to help users block distractions and concentrate.
cards.access_notes: First-floor Hamon space; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bridwell Library Current Periodicals Reading Room
cards.title: Bridwell Current Periodicals Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bridwell Library
cards.notes: Use the large four-person tables and reading lamps for a quiet session, especially if you want a windowed room close to library service points.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, windowed reading room with large tables, lamps, and electrical outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Libraries describes Bridwell’s Current Periodicals Reading Room as a quiet area with windows, large four-person tables, reading lamps, and electrical outlets.
cards.access_notes: Located near Bridwell circulation and reference offices; check library access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Dedman Center for Lifetime Sports
cards.subtitle: 6000 Bush Avenue · SMU Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Plan an active break using the indoor track, climbing and bouldering walls, courts, pool, or fitness areas; follow current recreation rules and entry policies.
cards.short_summary: SMU’s recreation center combines courts, climbing, pools, fitness space, and an indoor track.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU Campus Recreation lists the Dedman Center’s indoor track, climbing and bouldering walls, courts, pools, fitness floor, weight room, and other recreation facilities.
cards.source_title: Dedman Center for Lifetime Sports | SMU Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open to enrolled SMU students and members; guest passes are available. Hours and access rules are subject to change.
